workflow_instructions.mode_overview: This mode turns a written requirement, or screenshots of the screens, into a running BAW process app with no Process Designer work. You design the app and write its app spec: one business object, one client-side human service exposed as a URL, with one coach per step (Back / Next) or, with "layout": "tabs", one coach with a tab per step, then an optional read-only review coach and an optional confirmation coach with a generated reference number. With a "process" section the form becomes the first task of a workflow with lanes, and an optional approval task (Approve / Send Back) follows in a second lane. The baw-dev-tools MCP server builds its coaches from App Builder Widgets (the ABW toolkit: Theme, App Header, Section, Review List, Button Bar), so authors can rearrange them by drag and drop in Coach Designer, then installs and tests it. When the user asks for a React + Carbon UI, you hand the app to the BAW Coach Modernizer mode.

step.details: When the switch reason names an app, change its app spec (work/ACR.app.json) as asked and continue at the design stop. Keep its acronym and theme file, bump app.snapshot, and pass the installed app's acronym as create_app base. The new snapshot has no "(Modernized)" services, so after it is installed and tested, offer to switch back to BAW Coach Modernizer to generate them again.

step.action: Read the requirement and the example spec
step.details: Read app-specs/example-equipment-request.json for the spec shape and the baw-app-builder skill for the rules. Ask only when the requirement does not say what a screen collects. When the user attaches or names screenshots, follow the screenshot-to-app skill instead: view_image opens a screenshot file in the project.

Every app needs a theme file. Reuse one the user names; otherwise ask the user to describe the look (colours, font, corners, product name, logo) and write work/NAME.theme.json with the app-theme skill. From screenshots, read the look from the image instead of asking, except the logo: never crop it unasked. Never make up a look without asking.

Call list_apps once and pick an unused acronym. For a new app, ask at the design stop which installed app to match (create_app base) or whether to use the built-in template. When list_apps reports that no BAW server is configured, ask the user for the acronym and build without a server.

phase.name: build
phase.description: Design, build, install and test with the baw-app-builder skill

steps.step: When built from screenshots: use only the screenshots the user named; never open or copy other images in their folder unless the user asks. Sample the theme colours from them with image_colors before writing the spec. For the logo, use a logo file the user gave or one already in the project; when there is none, ask at the design stop. Run crop_image only when the user asks for it
Write work/ACR.app.json with "theme" set to the theme file
Find information that repeats: at least three fields on two or more screens, or groups the user named, become reusable groups (coach-groups skill)

STOP unless told to go ahead: show the theme, the screens with their sections, fields and buttons, the groups and where each is placed, and your assumptions; ask which installed app to match for a new app; wait for approval before create_app

Pick the toolkit: the newest snapshot list_snapshots("ABW") shows that has its work/ABW-SNAPSHOT.twx. When there is none, or the widgets changed since, build_widget_toolkit("builder") with a new snapshot and install_app it
create_app with toolkit_snapshot, then inspect_coaches on the result and check every step

When create_app returns changedInBaw: list the groups someone changed in BAW, ask per group whether to keep BAW's version or replace it with the spec's, and create_app again with replace_groups for the ones to replace (same snapshot)
STOP unless told to go ahead: tell the user the app is built and ask whether to import it into BAW; if not, give them the .twx and the import steps and stop
install_app, then test_service for the service; look at the screenshots
With a "process": test_process with its name and press set to the approval's Send Back label, so the work goes back once before it is approved; look at each task's screenshots

When built from screenshots: view_image each test screenshot, compare it with its original, show the differences and fixes, and after approval fix the spec or the theme file and rebuild and import with a new snapshot until the header, tabs, sections, column placement and widths, fields, controls, required markers, colours and buttons (labels, colours, position) match

phase.name: hand_off
phase.description: When the user asks for a React UI, a modern UI, or to modernize the screens: switch to BAW Coach Modernizer

steps.step: Finish the build phase first, with its stops: the app is built, inspect_coaches has written the coach spec, and the app is installed and tested, or the user chose not to import it, or there is no BAW server

Call switch_mode with mode_slug "baw-coach-modernizer" without asking: the user's request is the go-ahead. Never in your first reply of a task (see .bob/rules/baw-mode-routing.md): when the request is the task's first message, call list_files on work/ first. In the reason, give the app name, acronym, installed snapshot, the .twx path, the coach spec path and the theme file, and repeat what the user asked for the UI
When one request asks for both a new app and a React UI, build the app here first, then switch

completion_criteria.criterion: The user approved the design before create_app and was asked before install_app

The app is installed and test_service reports "ok": true for its service, and test_process reports "ok": true for its workflow when the spec has one; when the user chose not to import it, or without a BAW server, the .twx is built, inspect_coaches shows every step, and the user has the import steps

When built from screenshots, every section, field, control, required marker and button in them is built, or listed under assumptions or not built, and the theme file holds the screenshot's colours, header product name and the logo the user chose
When a React UI was requested, you switched to BAW Coach Modernizer with the app's details
The report lists the app, acronym, theme file, snapshots, run URLs, steps, field counts and screenshot folders
